---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something NOPAL should do
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
Describe the situation where NOPAL currently falls short — not the feature itself yet.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like NOPAL to do about it.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why they're worse.

**Would this need new hardware support?**
If it involves a specific machine/board NOPAL doesn't talk to yet, consider registering it at [charlymigenes-ux.github.io/nopal/colabora](https://charlymigenes-ux.github.io/nopal/colabora/) too.

**Additional context**
Anything else — screenshots, links, similar features in other tools.
